m: वैबाध m. (fr. वि-बाध) ‘that which forces asunder’, N. of the Aśvattha tree, AV.
वैबाध—प्रणुत्त (˚ध-), mfn. forced asunder by the Aśvattha tree, ib.
वैबोधिक m. (fr. वि-बोध) one who awakens (princes by announcing the time &c.), a bard, panegyrist, Kir.
a: वैबोधिकः — 1 A watchman. --2 Especially, one who awakens sleepers by announcing the time; वैबोधिकध्वनिविभावितपश्चिमार्धा (रात्रिः) Ki. 9. 74.

m: वैबुध mf(ई)n. (fr. वि-बुध) belonging or peculiar to the gods, divine, Śiś.; Kathās.; Alaṃkārat.
